Abhaktārthapratyākhyāna
Jain. BORI. D. XVII. iii. 940.

Abhakṣyadvātriṃśikā
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 148.

Abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaprāyaścitta
PUL. I. p. 78.

Abhakṣyabhakṣyaprakaraṇa
dh. Oppert I. 7262.

Abhakṣyānnanirūpaṇa

Abhaya
Bud.
--Devīkālīstotra. Cordier III. p. 199.
--Mahākālastotra. Cordier III. p. 197.

Abhaya
Bud. Pāli writer of Pagan; 14th cent.
--Saddatthabhedacintā mahāṭīkā.
--Sambandhacintā ṭīkā, C. on Saṅgharakkhita's Sambandhacintā on Pāli verb an. syntax.
See Gandhavamsa p.. 63-74. Bode, Pāli. Lit. Burma, p. 22; Law, His.. Pāli Lit. p. 591; Malalasekara, Pāli Lit. Ceylon p. 199.

Abhaya(bhūpati)
king.
--Padakhaṇḍana, a critique of definitions of grammar-concepts, pada, kartṛ, karma, karaṇa, sampradāna an. other kārakas, kriyā, kāla, sambandha etc. Petrograd 108.

Abhayakalidhāraṇī
Bud. Camb. Uni. Bud. p. 106.

Abhayakīrti
Bud.
--Ajitanāthastuti Mṛtyuvañcanānāma. Cordier III. p. 99.
--Śrīcakrasamvarasādhana. Cordier III. p. 102.

Abhayakīrti
Jain.
--Puṣpāñjali mahākāvya in Skt. Moodbidri II. 790 (d).

Abhayakumāra
civil name of the Jain teacher Abhayadeva Sūri, commentator on the nine Aṅgas. Peters. IV. Index of Authors, p. iv. [Page273-a.

Abhayakumārakathā
Jain. Cabaton III. 733 (1).

Abhayakumāragaṇi
Jain. assisted Vijayasiṁha Sūri in the composition of his Dharmopadeśamālāvṛtti in A. D. 1135. See Peters. V. p. 90. śl. 22.

Abhayakumāracaritra
Jain. Chani 925. Jainagranthāvalī p. 220.

Abhayakumāracaritra
Jain. kāvya in Skt. by Candratilakopādhyāya, (13th cent. A. D.), pupil of Jineśvara of Kharatara gaccha an. Sūraprabha. Jainagranthāvalī p. 220. JBhP. I. 93. Jesalmere p. 4. Skt. Intro. p. 49 fn., Mandlik. Sup. 231 (inc.).
Edn.. (1) Surat, 1917. (2) Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1917.

Abhayakumārasurasundarīkathā
Jain. Chani 2664.

Abhayakulaka
Jain. work. Jainagranthāvalī p. 195.

Abhayakuśala
Jain. Śvet.
--C. Vṛtti on Camatkāracintāmaṇi. jy. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 114.

Abhayakuśala
Jain. Śvet.
--Vivāhapaṭala. jy. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. IV. ii. p. 113.

Abhayagaṇi
Jain.
--Subhadrācaritra (Apabhraṁśa). Pattan I. p. 158.

Abhayaṅkaramantra
MT. 1517 (v. (fol. 203b-204a).

Abhayaṅkaravidhi
śaivāgama; from a Pūjāpaddhati according to the Kāraṇāgama. Mysore I. p. 597.

Abhayaṅkarīnāmadhāraṇī
Bud. AS. p. 243. Cabaton I. 62 (16). Nepal II. p. 252. Oxf. II. 1449 (31). SBL. Nepal p. 292.

Abhayacandra
father of Mādhava (1540 A. D.) of the court of Rewa an. a. of Vīrabhānūdayakāvya.
See JRAS (1927) 871. an. P. K. Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. II. p. 30. [Page273-b]

Abhayacandra
Jain.
His pupil Keśavavarṇin rendered into Canarese his C. on Gommaṭasāra in A. D. 1359. (Ind. Ant. 1916, p. 27); commented on the works of Nemicandra who was a preceptor of Cāmuṇḍarāya, C. 975. A. D.
--Karmaprakṛti.
Jinasena 2. MD. 5163. Moodbidri I. 41 (2). II. 87 (b). 121 (c). 186 (b). 245 (a.. Mysore I. p. 553.
--Gommaṭasāra or Pañcasaṅgraha (Saṁskṛta) vyākhyā, Mandaprabodhikā. Moodbidri II. 66 (a. (Jīvakāṇda). 66 (b) (Karmakāṇḍa). 790 (e). Pannalal Bombay I. p. 42. Śravaṇabelagola 224.
Pt.. Jīvakāṇḍa portion in Gandhi Haribhai Devakarana Jaina Granthamālā 4.
--Trilokasāravyākhyāna. Moodbidri II. 135 (a..
--Prakriyāsaṅgraha on the Śākaṭāyanavyākaraṇa. CPB. 7629-30. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 93. IO. 5049-51. MD. 1534-8. Moodbidri II. 714.
Ed.. D.. Oppert, Madras, 1893.
--Bhavyajanakaṇṭharatnābharaṇa. Moodbidri II. 299 (c).

Abhayacandra
Jain.
--C. Tātparyavṛtti called Syādvādabhūṣaṇa on Akalaṅka's Laghīyastraya.
CPB. 7845. Moodbidri II. 235 (a.. Rice 306. Pt.. Māṇik. Dig. Jain. Granth. 1. 1915.

Abhayacandra
Jain.
--Aṣṭasahasrīṭippaṇa. Śravaṇabelgola p. 128a.

Abhayacandra
Jain. Śvet. Kharataragaccha, pupil of Ānandarāya. [Page274-a.
--Ulluṇṭhavādimukhakīlaka. jy. Pkt. BBRAS. 299 (ms. dated Saṁ. 1557).

Abhayacandra
Jain.
--Subhāṣita. Bikaner 10149.

Abhayacandra
Jain; of the Sādhu Pūrṇimā gaccha, teacher of Rāmacandra Sūri of Stambhatīrtha. (a. of Pañcadaṇḍātapatracchatrabandha or Vikramādityacaritra, composed in A. D. 1434). BBRAS. 1746. Weber 1580.

Abhayacandra
Jain. teacher of Nemicandra, 16th cent. A. D. (Pravacanaparīkṣā, Arhatpratiṣṭhāsārasaṅgraha etc.).
Praśasti Saṁgraha p. 101.

Abhayacandra
Jain. teacher of Harikalaśa Miśra. Mentioned in IO. Keith, p. 1262a.

Abhayacandramuni
grand preceptor of Pārśvadeva, (a. of Saṅgītasamayasāra, MD. 13028).

Abhayatādānanāma_Aparājita
Bud. Kanjur Kyoto 297.

Abhayatilaka
Jain. pupil of Lakṣmītilaka an. Jineśvara Sūri.
--Dvyaśrayakāvyavṛtti, written in A. D. 1256. BBRAS. 1737. Bombay 1879-82, p. 7. BORI. 225 of 1902-07. CPB. 7406-7407. JBhP. I. 1287. Jesalmere p. 22. Pattan I. p.. 151. 166. 216. Peters. V. p. 288 (no. 727).
Pt.. Ed.. Bomb. Skt. Ser. 69. 76.
--Nyāyālaṅkāraṭippaṇa, seems to be a C. on Udayana's Pariśuddhi which is a gloss on Vācaspati's Nyāya sūtra-bhāṣya-vārttika-tātparyaṭīkā. As Udayana's is the fifth super C. on Akṣapada's Nyāya sūtras, this C. thereon of Abhayatilaka is called Panca prasthāna-nyāyatarkavyākhyā. The a. says that he wrote it on finding Śrīkaṇṭha's C. on Udayana too difficult.
Jainagranthāvalī p. 96. Jesalmere [Page274-b] p.. 47-48. Skt. Intro. p.. 31-2. See also Praśasti I. p. 15.
Mentioned by Guṇaratna in his Ṣaḍdarśanasamuccayavṛtti.
--Śrāvakadharmaprakaraṇavṛtti.
Seems to be a joint production of Lakṣmītilaka an. Abhayatilaka. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 152. 189.

Abhayadattaśrī
Bud.
--Caturaśītisiddhipravṛtti. Cordier III. p. 247.
--Same with Dohāvṛtti. ibid. p.. 247-8.

Abhayadapraśna(śakunamuṣṭi)
jy. Adyar II. p. 52b (2 mss.).

Abhayadeva
Jain. logician of Candragaccha; pupil of Pradyumnasūri of Rājagaccha; his successor an. pupil of Jineśvara was a contemporary of King Muñja (C. 974-995 A. D.); 9th predecessor of Māṇikyacandra who wrote Parśvanāthacarita in 1219 A. D.) (Peters. III. p. 159); also 9th predecessor of Siddhasenasūri (Pravacanasāroddhāravṛtti, A. D. 1185; Weber 1938). See also Peters. IV. Index of Authors, p. iii.
--Vādamahārṇava. Mss. not yet traced; mentioned by his successors; some suggest it may be another name of the Sammatitarkaṭīkā given below.
--Sammatitarkaṭīkā, Tattvabodhavidhāyinī, C. on Siddhasena Divākara's Sammatitarka.
BORI. 1416 of 1887-91. Jainagranthāvalī p. 79. L. 3290.

Abhayadeva
Jain. teacher of Śānti Sūri or Śāntyācārya (a. of a C. Śiṣyahitā on the Uttarādhyayanasūtra). Weber 1907-1910. May be identical with the previous. [Page275-a.

Abhayadeva
Jain. 42nd in the Bṛhat Kharatara gaccha; successor of Jinacandra an. predecessor of Jinavallabha; born a. Dhārā of Dhanadevī an. Dhana, a Śreṣṭhin; civil name Abhayakumāra; pupil of Jineśvara an. Buddhisāgara of the Candrakula; mentions one Droṇācārya of Nirvṛtakula a. a contemporary of his who had approved of his writing; ordained in A. D. 1031; died a. Kappaḍa vaṇija grama in Gurjara country, C. 1075 or 1082 A. D.; known a. Navāṅgī-commentator. See Ind. Ant. XI. p. 248. See also Saṅghapaṭṭaka of his successor Jinavallabha, IO. Keith, p. 1320; Peters. IV. Index of Authors, p.. iv-v..
--Anuttaropapātikadaśāsūtravṛtti. BORI. D. XVII. i. 154. Weber 1810.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1920.
--Antakṛddaśāsūtravṛtti. BORI. D. XVII. i. 145. Weber 1806.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1920.
--Aṣṭakavṛtti, C. on Haribhadra's Aṣṭakaprakaraṇa; the C. was written by Jineśvara an. corrected by Abhayadeva, though catalogues ascribe it to the latter.
Peters. III. Extr. p. 309. VI. p. 111 (no. 545).
--Āgamāṣṭottarī. BORI. 1082 of 1887-91. Jainagranthāvalī p. 169. JBhP. I. 161.
--Ācāravidhi or Sāmācārī. Jainagranthāvalī p. 155.
--Ārādhanākulaka, in 85 Gāthas. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 169. 196. Peters. I. App. p.. 17. 84. III. p. 24.
--[Upadhānapañcāśaka or Pañcāśaka. Peters. III. Extr. 45. Same probably [Page275-b] a. his C. on Haribhadra's Pañcāśaka for which see below.]
--Upāsakadaśāsūtravṛtti. BORI. D. XVII. i. 138-139. Weber 1802-4.
Ed.. Bib. Ind. 1888-90; Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1919.
--Aupapātikasūtravṛtti, C. on the first Upāṅga. BORI. D. XVII. i. 184. Weber 1824.
Ed.. Āgamolaya Samiti Series, 1916.
--Jayatihuyaṇastotra or (Stambaṇaka) Pārśvanātha-stavana, in Pkt.; composed in A. D. 1054; with this Abhayadeva revived the Pārśvanāthatīrtha a. Stambhaṇaka. Bikaner 9805. Bomb. Uni. 2406 (12). BORI. 349 (g) of Ā882-83. C.. X. C. 40. Hpr. IV. 348. JBhP. I. 1659. Jainagranthāvalī p. 279. Peters. I. 350. III. Extr. p. 245. Filliozat II. p. 164, Pārśvamantrastava, is same.
Ed.. Ahmedabad, 1890.
--Jñātādharmakathāsūtravṛtti, written in A. D. 1063. BORI. D. XVII. i. 129-130. Weber 1792.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1919.
--C. on Jinacandra's Navatattvaprakaraṇa. BORI. 1198 of 1884-87. 1275 of 1886-92. Jainagranthāvalī p. 125.
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, no. 10. Bhavanagar, 1912.
--Nigodaṣaṭtriṁśikā. on Nigodas in 36 Pkt. verses; held by some to be old an. only q. by Abhayadeva. BORI. D. XVII. i. 106-110. Peters. III. Extr. p. 212. Weber 1967 (10).
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1917; Āgamodaya Samiti Series 9.
--Pañcanirgranthasaṅgrahaṇī, 107 Pkt. gāthās on the five kinds of Nirgranthas, [Page276-a. based on Bhagavatīsūtra XXV. v.. BORI. D. XVII. i. 111-4.
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1917.
--C. on Haribhadra's Pañcāśaka, composed a. Dhavalakka in A. D. 1067.
BORI. 1196 of 1887-91. See also Weber II. p.. 889-920.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1919.
--Paramāṇukhaṇḍaṣaṭtriṁśikā, in 36 Pkt. verses, on Pudgalas, with Skt. elucidation; based on Bhagavatīsūtra V. 7. Taken by some to be old an. only q. by Abhayadeva. BORI. D. XVII. i. 97-100.
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1917; Āgamodaya Samiti Series 8.
--Pudgalatriṁśikā, on Pudgalas based on Bhagavatīsūtra V. 8. Held by some to be old an. only q. by Abhayadeva in his C. on Bhagavatīsūtra. BORI. D. XVII. i. 101-104.
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1917; Āgamodaya Samiti Series 10.
--Prajñāpanatṛtīyapādasaṅgrahaṇī, in 133 Pkt. gāthās, on the Alpatvabahutva of beings, based on Prajñāpanā Sūtra, III. BORI. D. XVII. i. 222-3.
--Praśnavyākaraṇasūtravṛtti; looked over by Droṇācārya. BORI. D. XVII. i. 162-3. Weber 1817.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1919.
--Bandhaṣaṭtriṁśikā (Bhagavatīsūtra, VIII. 9). Not Abhayadeva's according to some. BORI. D. XVII. i. 105. [Page276-b]
Ed.. Jaina Ātmānanda Sabhā, Bhavanagar, 1912; Āgamodaya Samiti Series 11.
--Bhagavatīsūtravṛtti; written a. Anahilwad in A. D. 1071, assisted by Yaśaścandra an. approved by Droṇa. BORI. D. XVII. i. 92. JASB. 1908, p. 427b (nos. 956 an. 2561). Weber 1789.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series nos. 12-14.
--Vipākasūtravṛtti. BORI. D. XVII. i. 177. Weber 1818.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series, 1920.
--Ṣaṭsthānakabhāṣya, C. on Jineśvara's Ṣasṭsthānaprakaraṇa. Jainagranthāvalī p. 138. Pattan I. p.. 304. 365.
--Ṣoḍaśakavyākhyā, C. on Haribhadra's Ṣoḍaśakaprakaraṇa. BORI. 1355 of 1886-92. JBhP. I. 296. Kh. p. 7a. Peters. IV. p. 51 (no. 1335).
--Saptatikā (Sattarī) sūtrabhāṣya. a C. in Pkt. on the Gāthās on Karman by Candrarṣi Mahattara, supplemented by Devendra. Peters. III. Extr. p. 218. no. 54. Weber 1930.
--Samavāyāṅgasūtravṛtti; written a. Anahilwad in A. D. 1063. BORI. D. XVII. i. p. 79. Weber 1785 (p. 420).
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series 15.
--Sthānāṅgasūtraṭīkā, written a. Anahilwad in A. D. 1063, assisted by Yaśodeva an. approved by Droṇācārya an. other scholars. BORI. D. XVII. i. p. 65. Weber 1781.
Ed.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series nos. 21, 22. 1918, 1920.
A. C. on the second Upāṅga, Rājapraśnīyasūtra is also ascribed some in mss. to Abhayadeva; this is doubtful. [Page277-a.
See Ind. Ant. XI. p. 248 fn. ZDMG. XXXIII. p. 694.

Abhayadeva
--Pañcaparameṣṭhistava. Jainagranthāvalī p. 282. The entry is doubtful.

Abhayadeva
--Sādharmi(ka)kulaka. Jainagranthāvalī p. 204. JASB. 1908, p. 436 (no. 7406) (a..).

Abhayadeva
Jain. Maladhārin of the Praśnavāhakula, Koṭikagaṇa, Madhyamaśākhā, Sthūlabhadramunivaṁśa an. Harṣapurīyagaccha; honoured by King Karṇa of Gujarat (A. D. 1063-1093) an. other kings; pupil of Jayasiṁha Sūri; an. teacher of Hemacandra Sūri, a. of Bhavabhāvanā (1113 A. D.), Puṣpamālā (?) (BORI. 1209 of 1887-91), Jīvasamāsaṭīkā (Peters. I. App. p. 18), Anuyogadvāraṭīkā (Peters. III. Extr. p. 36), an. Śatakavṛtti (Kh. p.. 42-44). Peters. III. Extr. p. 156 (verse 9); p.. 132-3 (verses 2-3); p. 274 (verses 3-8). IV. Index of Authors, p. v..
Same a. the grand preceptor of Candra Sūri (Saṅgrahaṇī, Weber 1950).

Abhayadeva
Jain.
--(?) C. on Puṣpamāiāprakaraṇa of Hemacandra. BORI. 1202 of 1886-92 (Upadeśamalā). 1209 of 1887-91 (?) Peters. IV. p. 45 (no. 1202). [Page277-b]
This is evidently a mistake, Abhayadeva here standing for Hemacandra's guru, an. the C. being Hemacandra's own. See the previous entry.

Abhayadeva
Jain. pupil of Bhadreśvara; pupil of Deva Sūri (victor of Kumudacandra); teacher of Madanacandra, teacher of Munideva Sūri, a. of Śāntināthacarita (written in A. D. 1265).
--Ratnamañjarīkathā. Mentioned in the Praśasti to the Śāntināthacarita, Pattan I. p. 125, verse 7.

Abhayadeva
--Navasmaraṇavṛtti. JBhP. I. 1440.

Abhayadeva
--Mahāvīrastava in Pkt. JBhP. I. 2044.

Abhayadeva
Jain. of the Rudrapallīyagaccha; pupil of Vijayacandra an. Padmacandra, Jinaśekhara, Jinavallabha, Abhayadeva Sūri of Kharatara gaccha, the Navāṅgī commentator; given the title ‘Vādisiṁha’ by the king of Kāśī. (Weber II. p. 1089).
--Jayanta or Jayantavijaya kāvya in 19 sargas, composed in A. D. 1221. Peters. IV. Extr. p. 87 (no. 1248).
Pt.. K. M. 75.
Same a. the teacher of Devabhadra an. predecessor of Śrītilaka, mentioned by the latter in the Praśasti a. the end of his Gautamapṛcchāvṛtti, BBRAS. 1600.

Abhayadeva
of the Rudrapallīyagaccha, preceptor of Vardhamāna Sūri, who composed his Ācāradinakara in A. D. 1463. See NCC. II. p. 24a.

Abhayadeva
Jain. teacher of Vardhamāna, a. of Dharmaratnakaraṇḍikā an. C. written in A. D. 1115 in the village of Dāyikākūpa; devoted to King Jayasiṁha. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 48.

Abhayadeva
Jain. mentioned a. his guru by Candraprabha Mahattara in Vijayacandrakevalicarita written in A. D. 1070. Peters. VI. p. 48.

Abhayadeva_Sūri
Jain. pupil of Bhadreśvara Sūri an. preceptor of Āsaḍa (a. of the Vivekamañjari, written in A. D. 1191). Peters. III. Extr. p. 101.

Abhayadeva_Sūri
Jain. pupil of Śanti Sūri, pupil of Bhadreśvara Sūri; teacher of Paramānanda (a. of C. on Karmavipāka, Sāmācārīvidhi etc.) Peters. III. Extr. p. 7. Weber 1951.

Abhayadeva_Sūri
Jain.
--Stambhaṇa(ka)pārśvanāthastuti with C. Pkt. BORI. 349 (h) of Ā882-83. BORI. D. XIX. i. 566. Pārśvajinastavana, BP. p. 241b is perhaps same.

Abhayadevasūri
Jain. spiritual guide of Guṇākara Sūri of the Rudrapallīyagaccha, who composed a C. on the Bhaktāmarastotra [Page278-a. in A. D. 1369 a. Sarasvatīpaṭṭaṇa.
--Tijayapahuttastotra or Vṛddhistavana or Saptatijinastotra. (A. D. 1395). Bik. 1531. BORI. 1106 (72) of 1891-5. BORI. D. XIX. ii. 522. Jainagranthāvalī p. 280. Authorship however doubtful, Harṣakīrti a. of a C. on it mentioning Mānadeva a. its a. See BORI. D. XIX. ii. 526.

Abhayadevakumārakathā
Jain. Pkt. Weber 2011 (5).

Abhayadevaprabandha
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 213.

Abhayadevasūricaritra
Jain. Chani 3257.

Abhayadharma
Jain.
--Daśadṛṣṭāntakathānaka or Bālāvabodha, composed in 1522 A. D. a. the request of Kāraṇa, a merchant, for the use of the sons of Vācanācarya Sannāga.
C.. X. C. 123.

Abhayananda
Jain. pupil of Abhayasūri.
--Kusumamālā, a collection of instructive Pkt. verses. BORI. 1135 of 1887-91. CPB. 7112-7113.

Abhayānanda
guru of Ānandapūrṇa Vidyāsāgara (a. of Nyayacandrikā, MT. 2931).

Abhayanandi
Jain. [Page278-b]
--Pūjākalpa in Skt. Dig. Jain. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 38.

Abhayanandi
Jain.
--Snapanavidhi an. pūjā in Skt. Dig. Jain. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 41.

Abhayanandin
Jain. Dig. “C. 750 A. D.”
--Jainendravyākaraṇamahāvṛtti.
Pt.. Pandit Reprint, 1918.
Q. in Gaṇaratnamahodadhi, Eggeling edn. p.. 344. 360.

Abhayanandin
Jain. pupil of Guṇanandin.
In his Candraprabhacarita (IO. II. p. 1354b), Vīranandin mentions Abhayanandin a. his guru an. says that Abayanandin was a pupil of Guṇanandin.
Nemicandra Siddhānta Cakravarttin (guru of Rājamalla II, C. 978-984 A. D.), a. of Trailokyasāra etc. mentions him a. one of his gurus.
The ascription of Nemicandra's Trailokyasāra to Abhayanandin in BORI. 599 of 1875-6 an. Strassburg Dig. p. 7 is wrong.

Abhayanandin
Jain. Dig.
--Śreyovidhāna. Pannalal Bombay I. p. 49.

Abhayanandin_(?)
Jain.
--Prameyaratnamālā, C. on Māṇikyanandin's Parīkṣāmukha. CPB. 7659-61 (?)
The Prameyaratnamālā on the Parīkṣāmukha is known a. a work of Anantavīrya.

Abhayanirukta
dvai. Q. by Ānandatīrtha in Bhāgavatatatparyanirṇaya, Sarvamūla edn. p. 140b.

Abhayapaddhati
name of the C. on the Buddhakapālamahātantra, Bud., by Abhayākaragupta. [Page279-a. Cordier II. p. 107. RASB. I. 97.

Abhayapāṇi
Bud.
--Pratiṣṭhāvidhi. Cordier II. p. 157.

Abhayapāla
